01 · Brand at a glance

A community
that moves.

FitMeet is a platform that connects local sports enthusiasts — runners, cyclists, hikers, swimmers and many more — through events organized by the users themselves. The app brings together discovering nearby activities, organizing meetups and community chat into one simple experience.

The visual identity reflects that idea: a circular “radar” symbol representing the discovery of people and places around you, with a path leading out from the center toward new experiences. The green-to-cyan gradient brings energy, motion and a positive, active brand spirit.

App, every feature
Maps, routes, messaging, reminders, marketplace.

“Find your people. Move together.” isn't just a tagline — it's a product philosophy. Every feature in the app, from the map to the chat, exists to lower the barrier to doing something active together.
